tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Check the current status of a customer order (e.g., processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled).

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the order (e.g., 'ORD-12345').

tools.name: initiate_refund
tools.description: Initiate a refund for a customer order. Requires a reason for the refund request.

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the order to refund (e.g., 'ORD-12345').

reason.description: The reason for the refund (e.g., 'defective product', 'wrong item', 'changed mind').

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Track the shipping status and location of a customer's order shipment.

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the order to track (e.g., 'ORD-12345').

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Escalate the current customer issue to a human support agent for further assistance.

issue_summary.description: A brief summary of the customer's issue that needs human attention.

customer_id.description: The customer's unique identifier for agent reference.

tools.name: no_tool
tools.description: No tool invocation needed. The assistant responds directly without calling any function.
